ask_mic_tap.mt: 🎤 Agħfas Tkellem u tkellem — jew ikteb hawn taħt
ask_mic_tap.en: 🎤 Tap Speak, then talk — or type below

ask_err_perm.mt: Il-permess tal-mikrofonu mitfi — agħfas 🔒 fil-bar tal-indirizz → ħalli l-mikrofonu
ask_err_perm.en: Mic permission is off — tap 🔒 in the address bar → allow microphone

ask_err_mic.mt: Ma setax jintuża l-mikrofonu — jekk jogħġbok ikteb
ask_err_mic.en: Can't use the microphone — please type instead

ask_err_nospeech.mt: Ma nstema’ ebda leħen — agħfas Erġa’ tkellem
ask_err_nospeech.en: No voice heard — tap Speak again

ask_err_other.mt: Id-dħul bil-vuċi falla ({code}) — jekk jogħġbok ikteb
ask_err_other.en: Voice input failed ({code}) — please type instead

cf_privacy.mt: Ismek u l-ħin tal-konferma jintbagħtu lill-post tax-xogħol bħala rekord tat-taħriġ.
cf_privacy.en: Your name and confirmation time will be sent to the workplace as a training record.
